verse.text: I could have no greater joy than to hear that my children are following the truth.

video.title: Seeking God as a Family - Daily Devotion

reflection: John says his greatest joy wasn't wealth or recognition, but simply hearing that the people he'd poured into were still walking with God. That's the quiet win every dad is really playing for: not a perfect house or a big resume, but kids who, years from now, are still following Jesus because they watched their old man do it first. Some nights that means less about the perfect Bible lesson and more about just staying consistent and present so truth becomes something they've seen lived out, not just heard preached.
